title: Compliance Bulletin: Virtual Care Licensed States and Location Attestation
content:
Every Virtual Care visit type names the states in which the patient must be physically located during the encounter, and whether the patient attests their physical location at the start of every encounter.

## Licensed-state sets

The licensed-state setting takes one of two values:

- **OH** — Ohio only.
- **OH-KY-IN-PA-WV-MI** — Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana, Pennsylvania, West Virginia and Michigan.

## Settings by visit type

| Visit type | States in which the patient must be physically located | Location attested at the start of every encounter |
|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | OH | Yes |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | OH | Yes |
| Primary Care Video Visit | OH-KY-IN-PA-WV-MI | Yes |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | OH | Yes |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | OH-KY-IN-PA-WV-MI | Yes |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | OH-KY-IN-PA-WV-MI | Yes |

## By state

| Physical location during the encounter | Visit types whose licensed states include it |
|---|---|
| Ohio | All six visit types |
| Kentucky, Indiana, Pennsylvania, West Virginia or Michigan | Primary Care Video Visit, Specialty Video Follow-Up, On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care |
| Any other state | None |

## Points of reference

**Does a patient physically in Michigan fall within the licensed states of a Behavioral Health Video Visit?** No. The Behavioral Health Video Visit licensed-state setting is OH, which covers Ohio only.

**Does a patient physically in Kentucky fall within the licensed states of On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care?** Yes. Its setting is OH-KY-IN-PA-WV-MI, which includes Kentucky.

**Is the location attested for some visit types only?** No. The attestation setting is Yes on all six visit types.
